The Homogeny's second tier: a middle stirring ring, three more feed vessels and the outer spokes around the same controller. It mixes at§9 4 parallels§r and adds §9Degenerate Stellar Mixture§r: 72 L molten White Dwarf Matter + 72 L molten Black Dwarf Matter + 1,000 L Excited Stellar Plasma Mixture → 1,000 L in 60 s.

§5§lUPGRADE§r (permanent)
- Build the stirring ring: hologram stack 2. Each new vessel takes a fluid Input Hatch on top.
- Mix§9 100,000 L§r of Excited Stellar Plasma Mixture in this Homogeny.
- Right-click the §9Homogeny Tier II Core§r (Condensate Assembling) onto the controller. Sneak-punch with an empty hand returns it.
- Press Install in the GUI, or use a screwdriver:§9 10 minutes offline§r at UXV power. A mix already running finishes first. Progress shows in the GUI and the scanner, and survives a wrench.

Degenerate Stellar Mixture feeds the Homogeny T3, the Eternity Shell Casing and the Reality machines (Tier 14 - MAX). Three Galactic Shell cells on the stirring ring's outer face are reserved for Quasar ports, later.

[note]The Tier II Core is built from §9twice as many UMV parts§r (32 Field Generators, 64 Electric Pumps) for now: the pack's UXV Field Generator and Pump still need Universium, which only Eye T10 makes. UXV circuits are fine (the Polychrome or Dimensional Quantum Circuit).[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold a Homogeny Tier II Core and 1,000 L of Degenerate Stellar Mixture (claim before you install the core).
